native_result.query: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, how does the number of monuments and axes changes with elements of symbolic capital?
native_result.HypoA: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, the number of monuments and axes increases along with symbolic capital
native_result.HypoB: Between 3400 and 3000 BCE the counts of monuments and the deposition record of axes track each other tightly across the slice: both rise from below-average (ZMonument \u22120.46, ZBeil +0.37 at BCE 3400) to a clear joint peak at BCE 3200 (ZMonument +0.91, ZBeil +2.60, Pearson r = +0.87, Spearman \u03c1 = +0.62 on the 5 anchor observations), then re-converge to mildly positive values by BCE 3000 (ZMonument \u22120.36, ZBeil +0.80). The three symbolic-capital indicators do not share this peak: HatchetSword (\u2248 ZAxtSchwert, the axe-and-sword weapon-symbol class) is essentially flat across the slice (\u22120.43 throughout, peak-to-trough range 0.01\u03c3), Dagger (\u2248 ZDolch) is constant at \u22120.58, and HouseSize (\u2248 Zhausgr) is highest at the start (+2.05) and falls steadily to its slice minimum at BCE 3100 (\u22120.06) before a partial recovery to +0.19. Counter to an expectation of cross-symbol synchrony, monument counts and axes co-rise while the two weapon-symbol components stay flat and HouseSize declines \u2014 a co-trajectory of the built form with the axe/celt record that is decoupled from, and partly opposed to, the Hatchet-Swords / Daggers / HouseSize reading of symbolic capital. Monument size (ZMonumentSize / ZMW) moves opposite to the count (Pearson r \u2248 \u22120.20 vs ZMonument, r \u2248 \u22120.62 vs ZBeil), so the BCE 3200 spike is one of more, but not larger, monuments. As backdrop the pollen-based openness record (Belau PC1, the cross-site MEAN, and SMOOTH_MEAN_100y) rises across the slice (Belau_PC1_inter \u22121.16 \u2192 +1.65; MEAN \u22121.86 \u2192 +0.08; SMOOTH_MEAN_100y \u22121.81 \u2192 +0.20), so the monument-and-axes peak at BCE 3200 sits on a backdrop of rising, not falling, openness.

Sliced to CE -3400..-3000: TS indices 700-1100 (401 rows, 1-yr), capital indices 9-13 (5 rows, 100-yr bins BCE 3400/3300/3200/3100/3000), pollen CE indices -3400..-3000 (401 rows). 3.
